note: Expected live deployment. pilot_prepared means this repository has the package and the pilot is not active. It does not authorize sync, a settings change, a skill assignment, or a run. Set pilot_active only after the Board approves that deployment. pilot_active records that the live agent carries the Board-accepted deployment (generated package, required skill, --settings memory policy); it does not authorize agent runs, tool access, generation, or further live changes, each of which needs its own Board approval. rolled_back means the live agent is back on the legacy role body and the pilot skill created for this pilot is unassigned. Do not delete a company skill that already existed.

game-artist.skill_scope: Knowledge Delivery pilot skill for game-artist only. Not the deferred animation skill package (K5).
